title: Board-to-board SMD terminal strips
summary: Make a dual-row SMD terminal strip

parameters.label: Inherited solder mask expansion
parameters.help: The board's mask expansion per side. Without a board profile the generator uses its stand-alone estimate.

parameters.label: Insulator shorter than positions × pitch by
Insulator's bottom over the seating plane
Lands' outer edges, row to row
Alignment pin diameter at the insulator
Alignment pin diameter at its tip
Alignment pin length under the insulator
Alignment pins inside the outer positions by
Land pattern
parameters.help: The lands as given (a manufacturer's land pattern, or a board's own lands), one pad per item, each the generator ABI's pad in JSON in the package frame: key, terminal (a package terminal, or empty for a non-plated hole or a mechanical or fiducial pad), shape, at, rot_mdeg, side, hole, mask, paste, number, kind. Empty: the generator's own lands.

parameters.label: Pin table
parameters.help: The part's pins from its datasheet's pin table, one NUMBER=NAME:KIND per entry: the package terminal's number as the footprint numbers it, the pin's name as the datasheet writes it, and its kind: power_input (supply and ground pins), power_output (a regulator's output), input, output, open_drain or open_source (an output that only sinks or only sources, as a power-good flag), io (a GPIO: an input that can be an output), bidirectional, nc (a pin the datasheet says is not connected: never wired), reserved (a pin the datasheet reserves: never wired) or passive (analog and anything else). A terminal not listed keeps the generator's number as its name and is passive. Empty: no pin table.

parameters.label: Orderable part numbers
parameters.help: The manufacturer part numbers this part is exactly, one MANUFACTURER=MPN per entry, as the maker's ordering information prints them (Texas Instruments=TLV75733PDBVR); each becomes a manufacturer Part of the component, for the BOM. Empty: a generic part.

presets.name: Global fiducial Ø1.0 mm, 2.0 mm opening
presets.description: A global fiducial: a Ø1.0 mm bare copper dot in a Ø2.0 mm solder mask opening, the clear area the opening.

citation.document: JLCPCB Help Center, How to Add Edge Rails and Fiducials for PCB Assembly Orders (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/how-to-add-edge-rails-fiducials-for-pcb-assembly-order, read 2026-11-21)

presets.note: JLCPCB: "The recommended diameter of a fiducial marker is 1 mm." and "The solder mask opening should be twice the diameter of the exposed copper pad." The clear area is the opening: "This area should be equal in size to the solder mask clearance (e.g., 2.0 mm in diameter)." (JLCPCB blog, Fiducial Marks in PCB and SMT Assembly (https://jlcpcb.com/blog/fiducial-marks, updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-11-21)).

presets.name: Global fiducial Ø1.0 mm, 2.0 mm opening, both sides
presets.description: The Ø1.0 mm global fiducial with a second dot opposite it on the far side, for boards assembled on both sides.

citation.document: JLCPCB Help Center, How to Add Edge Rails and Fiducials for PCB Assembly Orders (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/how-to-add-edge-rails-fiducials-for-pcb-assembly-order, read 2026-11-21)

presets.note: Sizes as the 1.0 mm preset (JLCPCB). Both sides: "For a double-sided SMT assembly, you must have a set of global fiducials on both the top and bottom sides of the board." (JLCPCB blog, Fiducial Marks in PCB and SMT Assembly (https://jlcpcb.com/blog/fiducial-marks, updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-11-21)).

presets.name: Global fiducial Ø1.0 mm, 3.0 mm clear area
presets.description: A global fiducial: a Ø1.0 mm bare copper dot in a Ø3.0 mm solder mask opening and clear area (three times the dot's radius).

citation.document: PCBWay, Design Instruction: PCB Panelization, Breakaway Rails, Fiducial Marks, Tooling Holes (https://pcbway.com/helpcenter/design_instruction/PCB_Panelization__Breakaway_Rails__Fiducial_Marks__Tooling_Holes.html, read 2026-11-21)

presets.note: PCBWay: "The minimum diameter of a fiducial mark is 1.0mm, and the maximum diameter is 3.0mm."; a clear area "with a minimum radius of 2R", and "If a radius of 3R can be achieved, the machine recognition will be better"; "If soldermask is used, it should not cover the clear area", so the opening is the clear area.

presets.name: Local fiducial Ø1.0 mm, 2.0 mm opening
presets.description: A local fiducial for a fine-pitch part (0.5 mm pitch or less), placed in pairs diagonally across its land pattern: a Ø1.0 mm dot in a Ø2.0 mm opening and clear area.

citation.document: JLCPCB Help Center, How to Add Edge Rails and Fiducials for PCB Assembly Orders (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/how-to-add-edge-rails-fiducials-for-pcb-assembly-order, read 2026-11-21)

presets.note: Neither JLCPCB nor PCBWay gives local fiducials sizes of their own, so this is the global fiducial's size (JLCPCB's 1 mm dot in a 2 mm opening; PCBWay's smallest mark, 1.0 mm). When to use one: local fiducials are for fine-pitch components, "specifically those with a pitch of 0.5mm or less", and "Typically, two fiducial marks are placed diagonally opposite the component's land pattern." (JLCPCB blog, Fiducial Marks in PCB and SMT Assembly (https://jlcpcb.com/blog/fiducial-marks, updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-11-21)).

presets.name: ESP32-S31-WROOM-3
presets.description: Espressif ESP32-S31-WROOM-3: 22 × 30 × 3.5 mm LGA module, 25 + 22 + 25 + 22 pads at 0.85 mm, a 3 × 3 ground array turned 45° (pad 95), four corner pads (96–99) and a 6 mm antenna end.

citation.document: Espressif ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 & ESP32-S31-WROOM-3U Datasheet (pre-release), Figure 10-1 module dimensions and Figure 11-1 PCB land pattern

presets.note: The pad rows, pitch, outline and land pattern are the datasheet's (Figure 10-1, p. 64; Figure 11-1, p. 67); the ground array's turn and pitch were checked against Espressif's published footprint and STEP model, used as a dimension source only. The ground pad nearest the antenna is chamfered on the module; it is drawn square. The can size, board thickness and antenna meander are estimated. Soldermask black: the datasheet's cover drawing (pre-release v0.7, p. 1) shows a black board under the can, as Espressif's ESP32-S3 modules are made (no product photograph of this module found, 20 November 2026). Shield label: Espressif's mark (installed library artwork `espressif-logo`, drawn only where installed) over the module name, laid out as on Espressif's ESP32-S3 module cover drawing (datasheet v1.8, p. 1); the S31's orderable variants and certification are not in the pre-release datasheet, so it prints no variant, FCC ID or conformity mark. The pin table (names; type P a power pin, I an input, I/O/T a GPIO) is Table 3-1 ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 Pin Definitions, pp. 14–15 of the same datasheet: GND 1, 2, 26, 47, 48, 72–90 and 92–99 (95 the ground array, 96–99 the corner pads), NC 33–39 and 91 (nc: device not-connected, never wired), USB_DP and USB_DM passive (USB data, no GPIO), IO362 read as IO36 with its footnote; the pins' alternate functions are not in the table: a pinout document gives them. The orderable part numbers (part_numbers) are Table 1-1 ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 (ANT) Series Comparison, pp. 3–4.

presets.name: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1
presets.description: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1: 18 × 25.5 × 3.1 mm castellated module, 14 + 12 + 14 pads at 1.27 mm, a 3 × 3 ground array (pad 41), a 15.8 × 17.6 mm shield can and a 6 mm PCB antenna end.

citation.document: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U Datasheet, Figure 10-1 module dimensions and Figure 11-1 recommended PCB land pattern

presets.note: Outline, height, board thickness, pad rows (0.85 × 0.9 mm at 1.27 mm, pin 1 7.49 mm below the antenna edge, the bottom row from 2.015 mm), castellations (Ø0.55), the 3 × 3 ground array (0.9 mm pads in a 3.7 mm square, centred 7.5 mm from the left edge and 10.29 mm from the bottom), the can (15.8 × 17.6 mm, read 1.05 mm above the bottom edge) and the lands (1.5 × 0.9 mm, 0.5 mm beyond the edge; Figure 11-1, p. 45) from the datasheet. The antenna meander's trace, inset and turns are estimated from the top view; the emboss groove is estimated. Soldermask black, satin to matte, as product photographs of the module show (for example the DFRobot DFR0896 module, https://core-electronics.com.au/esp32-s3-wroom-1-n4-module-pcb-antenna.html, read 20 November 2026) and the datasheet's cover drawing (v1.8, p. 1); the antenna meander is black on black. Shield label: Espressif's mark (installed library artwork `espressif-logo`, drawn only where installed) over the module name, as on the datasheet's cover drawing (v1.8, p. 1), then the orderable variant of the placed part's number ({code}: the ordering codes of datasheet v1.8 Table 1-1, p. 3; ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 prints N16R8). FCC ID 2AC7Z-ESPS3WROOM1 from the FCC grant for model ESPS3WROOM1 (2.4 GHz Wi-Fi & BT IoT module, granted 21 January 2022; fccid.io listing read 20 November 2026) and the CE mark (installed artwork `ce-mark`); their place on the can is estimated, as the cover drawing shows neither. IC 21098-ESPS3WROOM1, the maker's name in Chinese (`espressif-company-zh`), the specification identifier (XX and {code}) and the Data Matrix as Espressif's laser-marking artwork for this module draws them (FCC 'Label' exhibit of 2AC7Z-ESPS3WROOM1, https://fccid.io/pdf.php?id=5637982, read 20 November 2026), laid out as the -1U's artwork (Espressif's WROOM-1 artwork centres the logo and name and prints no CE mark). The pin table (names; type P a power pin, I an input, I/O/T a GPIO) is Table 3-1 Pin Definitions, pp. 11–12 of the same datasheet; the ground array is pin 41, EPAD. IO19 and IO20 are also USB_D- and USB_D+, and the pins' alternate functions (Table 3-1's Function column) are not in the table: a pinout document gives them. The orderable part numbers (part_numbers) are the marking table's, the same ordering information.

presets.name: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U
presets.description: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U: 18 × 19.2 × 3.2 mm castellated module without a PCB antenna, 14 + 12 + 14 pads at 1.27 mm, a 3 × 3 ground array (pad 41), a 15.65 × 17.5 mm shield can notched at its +x +y corner for a U.FL (MHF I) antenna receptacle 3 mm from the right edge and 2.46 mm from the top.

citation.document: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U Datasheet, Figure 10-2 module dimensions and Figure 11-2 recommended PCB land pattern

presets.note: Outline (18 × 19.2 mm), height (3.2 mm), board thickness, pad rows (0.85 × 0.9 mm at 1.27 mm, pin 1 1.19 mm below the top edge, the bottom row from 2.015 mm), castellations (Ø0.55), the 3 × 3 ground array (0.9 mm pads in a 3.7 mm square, centred 7.5 mm from the left edge and 10.29 mm from the bottom), the can (15.65 × 17.5 mm, 1.1 mm above the bottom edge, its notch 4.9 × 4.4 mm from the 10.75 mm and 13.1 mm sections), the U.FL receptacle's centre (3 mm from the right edge, 2.46 mm from the top) and the lands (1.5 × 0.9 mm, 0.5 mm beyond the edge; Figure 11-2, p. 46) from the datasheet; the pads are the WROOM-1's at the same distance from the bottom edge. The can is centred across, as read from the top view (within 0.1 mm); the receptacle's body (2.6 mm square base, Ø2 mm shell, 1.25 mm tall) is a U.FL / MHF I receptacle's typical size, estimated. Soldermask black, as the datasheet's cover drawing (v1.8, p. 1) and Espressif's product image show, the same board as the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 (no photograph of the -1U itself found, 20 November 2026). Shield label as Espressif's laser-marking artwork for this module draws it, at the can's size: the FCC 'Label' exhibit of FCC ID 2AC7Z-ESPS3WROOM1U ('ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U laser marking 20220401', https://fccid.io/pdf.php?id=5799920, grant of 31 March 2022 to Espressif Systems (Shanghai) for model ESPS3WROOM1U, read 20 November 2026), with the MIC row Espressif's PCN20230802 adds (Appendix I, after change: the Japanese conformity mark, R 201-220894; first shipped 15 October 2023) and the CMIIT ID 2022DP8926(M) the PCN's label images print (blank in the 2022 artwork). Lines and places from the artwork: Espressif's logo (installed artwork `espressif-logo`), the module name, the CE mark (`ce-mark`) and MIC row, FCC ID:2AC7Z-ESPS3WROOM1U, IC: 21098-ESPS3WROOMU, CMIIT ID, the maker's name in Chinese (`espressif-company-zh`, the artwork's own glyphs), the specification identifier bottom left and the Data Matrix bottom right. The identifier is XX (Espressif's ESP32-S3 module packaging information, Module Silk Marking: XX or MN, mass production) and the variant of the placed part's number ({code}: the ordering codes of datasheet v1.8 Table 1-1, p. 3; ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N16R8 prints XXN16R8). The Data Matrix encodes 18 characters (two reserved, the date code YYWW, the module's MAC; same source): the placed part's datamatrix variable when set, else the sample XXYYWWMACMACMACMAC. The artwork's fonts (Helvetica Neue Medium and regular) are drawn in the built-in Liberation Sans at the artwork's line widths, the medium lines heavier. The pin table (names; type P a power pin, I an input, I/O/T a GPIO) is Table 3-1 Pin Definitions, pp. 11–12 of the same datasheet; the ground array is pin 41, EPAD. IO19 and IO20 are also USB_D- and USB_D+, and the pins' alternate functions (Table 3-1's Function column) are not in the table: a pinout document gives them. The orderable part numbers (part_numbers) are the marking table's, the same ordering information.

title: Pin table
summary: The part's pins from its datasheet's pin table, one NUMBER=NAME:KIND per entry: the package terminal's number as the footprint numbers it, the pin's name as the datasheet writes it, and its kind: power_input (supply and ground pins), power_output (a regulator's output), input, output, open_drain or open_source (an output that only sinks or only sources, as a power-good flag), io (a GPIO: an input that can be an output), bidirectional, nc (a pin the datasheet says is not connected: never wired), reserved (a pin the datasheet reserves: never wired) or passive (analog and anything else). A terminal not listed keeps the generator's number as its name and is passive. Empty: no pin table.
